fields.name: Campus IA, Fouju (Seine-et-Marne)
fields.operator: Campus IA project company (SAS). Majority ownership by MGX is asserted by a senator's written question, not confirmed by the government, so it is not stored as fact.
fields.notes: Power 1.4 GW and 10 to 12 data centres on 70 to 73 ha are from the senator's question (the project description), not from a government release. Ministerial answer of 30 July 2026: 700 MW contracted with RTE, with talks to increase within available capacity. Public inquiry ran 30 April to 30 May 2026. Investment figure (EUR 50 bn per secondary) is not used. Secondary: RTE fast-track contract of 26 Jan 2026 (240 MW by end-2027, 700 MW by end-2029) could not be probed (release text not extractable).
